name: Kiamal Solar Farm - Stage 1
current_developer: KSF Project Nominees Pty Ltd ATF KSF Project Trust
notable: 200 MW solar farm near Ouyen in Victoria's Mallee, developed by Total Eren (now TotalEnergies). One of the largest solar farms in Victoria. Stage 1 of a planned larger development.

timeline.title: Commercial operations commenced
timeline.detail: Commencement date from AEMO registration via OpenElectricity.

timeline.title: First generation recorded
timeline.detail: First market dispatch data recorded in AEMO systems.

timeline.title: COD estimate updated
timeline.detail: COD changed from 2026-01 to 2026-01-01 (source: AEMO Generation Information)

eis_specs.document_title: Kiamal Solar Farm — VIC-ESC Electricity Generation & Sale Licence Application
eis_specs.connection_substation_name: Kiamal Terminal Station (KMTS), tapped off 220 kV Red Cliffs–Murray Warra single-circuit line
eis_specs.notes: Total Eren; 200 MWac (256.5 MWp DC). Panels: TrinaSolar. 2 x 180 MVA 33/220 kV step-up transformers (Wilsons). 190 MVAr Siemens synchronous condenser installed for system-strength support. MRCC planning permit Sep 2017.
